(Good everyday running and walking shoe)

![IndyBest | The Independent Product Reviews From Our Experts](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2MuZF4cEf4Sr-FxZahpftDHIH8M7DLuU0CTYxr964pCbvPQwoY1pURgRWBVqzZ_wMIYnR4B-h4Q3AopJiNmbPU-qGp3L_heLoAbVwrUKpuVpTWAcRZUT-F9eOiDH4q-SKjGv0e1Z1LyTGJ2WLJ4UvGqY23PM46K5fjytdjkkp-yuTXYWAd8AwNPZbCFWZo22?purpose=fullsize)![Allbirds Womens Tree Dasher 1 Running Shoes (Geyser) | Sportpursuit.co](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/CMVO3KSa4pO2LYD_qAe4AKV7xUTun9FLaTMwDf2Gcsixlb4ikVueirmvUind55DHUtdJg3fpf2MQhMqIa832FxIxAIdZyFo8UHJz9QRkeWU6zOweJsRKPA8tkWVJlMZ9L4G4pBW-09ETnoybvsocbJMnCv159aN_nQP3rrdjZevAB_Tuyemsi8bJwEUbBP2I?purpose=fullsize)![Cut in half: Allbirds Tree Dasher Review | RunRepeat](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1tXMBO_Hc5p9x2RsgaCztl7n2wrLy5wXs1HcfR7bCf-uc6dHnmQxI7FgHCasNe9dhGaQIf5WEL-gWVRgcnJcq2UGK_pdPY0UzuCYory_4t8v4HYsTo9cXFmcffcsq7CfGQNJJjM9rT04HpMA09zn8bGPOw5bQ_uB4bPpO4h_Q8f4dKxKRFmPaj4zlEG48USR?purpose=fullsize)![Women's Tree Dasher 1

 – Allbirds ReRun](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uDoJJqgpC5llTQ8RI60skvrhtVFrxY2PKI2HG5UcuXZQnwc1ILOR03o1dJQCq-izHZ1EX-WehhvRH2clW5EoVYqXZxn4hGpNLk-ZzW_2V58JC2uWqkw0zMNIGjnqjntpDF6ftr13SCVAKFjJY_lwcav_SvMnNDfrelYMtktcb_8kThtoTF8aII7tEzU_oIQX?purpose=fullsize)![Allbirds Men's Tree Dasher - Medium Grey – shopcardinoshoes.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/qPYoNGFl-sCiKQhYektBwyoh6Y2Sc-uSGELVYP0zITPhjjYyTJprLoTFvXHNAQOTmWsixI-NxW5UDK_WQepApTx_vWOb-3gbj0dvbPCaD9xaHhzxhZrPhNVM_ZrvgPmuyD-aEJoW2TA_T4iVbxlWUESiu_Ghpqc8HPTy5fUEkMPWS6E3okGQtu84BY3DPATs?purpose=fullsize)

**My verdict: The Allbirds Tree Dasher is a comfortable, attractive hybrid running and lifestyle shoe, but it's not a top-tier performance running shoe.**

After comparing several independent reviews, there's a consistent pattern: excellent everyday comfort, decent cushioning, and some limitations when running longer distances.

## What reviewers like

![Allbirds Tree Dasher Running Shoe Review](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/AAHjSU8kq_PWZHyTNHxnH1fFu4z9is8zWUbGuIKFHWHBtXSWvtQTmCS_bX5TgO4bWbjrKMTGLbF9qDEpf_aNVCqM257TKfSthUoUqjTwe6Lp8eCvByAGzrzbv9-r_PC5xQfpyNWx3mVRTDHE5KryCTOh5TdYmaLuWqWRoOqIg--yMwCwr0RFEAk4Vic_Sq8P?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Breathable, comfortable upper**

The eucalyptus-fiber knit is soft, flexible and breathable. Reviewers particularly like the roomy toe box.

![Allbirds Tree Dasher | First Look at New Running Shoes](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wneTDpgirOesC2d_eq2GT7DPGg3DsWIzzi6mdb7eotCTKliAQKR1E2ZazGOTNmTKtMC3Vqfua0pPtQ-KhILQl2IBvionSpmQRnSofkBWCGrB6WdDVTmNVNzSKbh4Y3_TShSrmKCf9JedFpKDZC7pMczEDLr3B6sLNaEW66dMEPcgAC9T2TC6NU20YaYBo52j?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Good cushioning**

The sugarcane-based SweetFoam midsole provides a cushioned but relatively firm ride. It feels supportive without being overly squishy.

![Women's Tree Dasher 2 - Active Shoes | Allbirds](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xWN6pEnDB_NL3YY70Wtge0ASL30vjNZrCbev_WXjgF79lEzEzfgHCyd9oQL7VlUoimgwz5kWdfDMRK4Pq1evLOmaa0G9hJaf-PaZ9Wd9EZ8spal0KHM7VcQ9LMncqxZYbpcJlMIY3kHCq2OtzG0GcSUPBHhzSowos3oOF17XzE9uxwvfSjXF5N7fTh9ZGxzz?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Versatility**

They work well for errands, travel, walking, gym workouts and shorter runs.

Sources: [www.techradar.com](https://www.techradar.com/reviews/allbirds-tree-dasher?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.runnersworld.com](https://www.runnersworld.com/gear/a32292816/allbirds-tree-dasher-running-shoe-review/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[barbend.com](https://barbend.com/allbirds-tree-dashers-review/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What reviewers dislike

- **Weight\:** Heavier than many dedicated running shoes.
- **Wet-weather traction\:** Grip can be poor on wet surfaces.
- **Long-distance running\:** Cushioning and support aren't ideal for longer mileage.
- **Heel and ankle rubbing\:** Some reviewers experienced friction around the ankle.
- **Stability\:** Not structured enough for runners who need substantial stability support.

## What about the Tree Dasher 2?

![Men's Tree Dasher 2 - Active Shoes | Allbirds](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/zo7Er7W__IcAjlU5rdvh_z9UbkdD1b1UmKXkexEgrATxLCyvHcs7P0MurXYZiESmm1vTMB4-kh8yo9P_Rmocy-MCB8IWGMS7ABa53dN75ALG2UenW8AnGMmc2sR1O6c_p1EpRm-ykp64KrVocsK7AOJ8Un5lTZ_rWmb8aE94pwuYsnkURhN2j9T9CoE70-z8?purpose=fullsize)

**Women's Tree Dasher 2**

# \$140.00

4.5/5 ·  reviews

Improvements include more responsive foam, extra grip and a revised fit.

Available from Allbirds\.

[View Tree Dasher 2](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-tree-dashers?utm_campaign=openai_catalog&utm_content=product_card&utm_medium=feed&variant=39656306147408&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Runner's World found the second generation improved heel fit, but testers still wanted more cushioning on longer runs. [www.runnersworld.com](https://www.runnersworld.com/gear/a40678013/allbirds-tree-dasher-2-review/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.zappos.com](https://www.zappos.com/product/review/9973606/page/1?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My buying recommendation

| Intended use | Verdict |
|--------|--------|
| Everyday walking | Very good |
| Travel | Very good |
| Standing all day | Good, depending on foot shape |
| Casual 5K runs | Good |
| Regular 10K+ runs | Look elsewhere |
| Speed training | Not my first choice |
| Wet-weather running | Not recommended |


## Bottom line

I'd buy the Tree Dasher if you want one attractive shoe for walking, travel, everyday activities and occasional jogging.

I'd choose a dedicated running shoe if your primary goal is running performance, longer distances or maximum cushioning.

---

## One question that would help me narrow this down\:

**What are you primarily considering the Tree Dasher for?**

- Walking and everyday comfort
- Traveling and walking all day
- Running 3–5 miles
- Running 5–10+ miles
- Standing all day at work

I can compare it against alternatives from HOKA, Brooks, ASICS and New Balance based on your intended use.

## My buying recommendation

| Intended use | Verdict |
|--------|--------|
| Everyday walking | Very good |
| Travel | Very good |
| Standing all day | Good, depending on foot shape |
| Casual 5K runs | Good |
| Regular 10K+ runs | Look elsewhere |
| Speed training | Not my first choice |
| Wet-weather running | Not recommended |

## Bottom line

I'd buy the Tree Dasher if you want one attractive shoe for walking, travel, everyday activities and occasional jogging.

I'd choose a dedicated running shoe if your primary goal is running performance, longer distances or maximum cushioning.

---

## One question that would help me narrow this down\:

**What are you primarily considering the Tree Dasher for?**

- Walking and everyday comfort
- Traveling and walking all day
- Running 3–5 miles
- Running 5–10+ miles
- Standing all day at work

I can compare it against alternatives from HOKA, Brooks, ASICS and New Balance based on your intended use.
